title: 🛡️ Sentinel: [MEDIUM] Fix insecure temporary file creation in tests
body:
🚨 Severity: MEDIUM
💡 Vulnerability: Insecure Temporary File Creation (CWE-377) via hardcoded `/tmp/...` paths in BATS test suites.
🎯 Impact: Using predictable, hardcoded temporary file paths in a world-writable directory (`/tmp/`) allows an attacker to perform symlink attacks. If an attacker pre-creates the expected files as symbolic links to sensitive system files, the execution of the test suite can lead to unintended modification or deletion of those sensitive files.
🔧 Fix: Refactored `test_network-copy.bats` and `test_encode-all.bats` to replace static `/tmp/...` paths with a dynamically generated temporary directory variable (`$TEST_TEMP_DIR`), securely created using `mktemp -d` and properly cleaned up in a `teardown()` function.
✅ Verification: Ran `bats test_network-copy.bats` and `bats test_encode-all.bats`, confirming both suites pass successfully with the dynamic paths. Also verified that `rm -rf "$TEST_TEMP_DIR"` cleans up the directories correctly.
